lines.text: What foul abomination is this! The Orbital Spire... covered in Caliginous Material, as though to fashion some new thing. And underneath it all... surely the thing lies there. I must devise a mean to let mine original self know...
Hm? I am receiving a summons from the original. It proceedeth from... the Orbital Spire.
This doth bode some event most ill.
Here I shall hide this recording device. Should I meet a dire fate, may that the one hearing this will discern the perilous change that befalls this world.
